mapper.select: SELECT e.*, o.order_id AS po_order_id, o.order_no AS po_order_no, o.product_id AS po_product_id, o.product_code AS po_product_code, o.product_name AS po_product_name, o.product_spec AS po_product_spec, o.product_unit AS po_product_unit, o.planned_quantity AS po_planned_quantity, o.completed_quantity AS po_completed_quantity, o.order_status AS po_order_status FROM production_operation_execution e LEFT JOIN production_order o ON e.order_id = o.order_id WHERE e.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY e.process_order ASC
SELECT * FROM production_operation_execution WHERE execution_status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY planned_start_time ASC
SELECT * FROM production_operation_execution WHERE execution_status = 'IN_PROGRESS' ORDER BY actual_start_time ASC
SELECT * FROM production_operation_execution WHERE execution_status = 'COMPLETED' AND actual_end_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} ORDER BY actual_end_time DESC
SELECT * FROM production_operation_execution WHERE execution_status IN ('PENDING', 'IN_PROGRESS') AND planned_end_time IS NOT NULL AND planned_end_time < NOW() ORDER BY planned_end_time ASC

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalExecutions, SUM(CASE WHEN execution_status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN execution_status = 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS processingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN execution_status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN execution_status = 'SKIPPED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS skippedCount, COALESCE(SUM(output_quantity), 0) AS totalOutput, COALESCE(SUM(qualified_quantity), 0) AS totalQualified, COALESCE(SUM(defective_quantity), 0) AS totalDefective, COALESCE(SUM(actual_labor_hours), 0) AS totalLaborHours, COALESCE(SUM(actual_machine_hours), 0) AS totalMachineHours FROM production_operation_execution WHERE order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT operator_id AS operatorId, operator_name AS operatorName, COUNT(*) AS totalExecutions, SUM(CASE WHEN execution_status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completedCount, COALESCE(SUM(output_quantity), 0) AS totalOutput, COALESCE(SUM(qualified_quantity), 0) AS totalQualified, COALESCE(SUM(actual_labor_hours), 0) AS totalLaborHours, CASE WHEN SUM(output_quantity) > 0 THEN COALESCE(SUM(qualified_quantity) * 100.0 / SUM(output_quantity), 0) ELSE 0 END AS avgQualifiedRate FROM production_operation_execution WHERE operator_id = #{operatorId} AND actual_end_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY operator_id, operator_name

SELECT equipment_id AS equipmentId, equipment_code AS equipmentCode, equipment_name AS equipmentName, COUNT(*) AS totalExecutions, SUM(CASE WHEN execution_status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completedCount, COALESCE(SUM(output_quantity), 0) AS totalOutput, COALESCE(SUM(actual_machine_hours), 0) AS totalMachineHours, CASE WHEN SUM(actual_machine_hours) > 0 THEN 100.0 ELSE 0 END AS utilizationRate FROM production_operation_execution WHERE equipment_id = #{equipmentId} AND actual_end_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY equipment_id, equipment_code, equipment_name
